# VRChat triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## Avatar changed

Runs when you switch to another avatar in VRChat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Avatar ids** | Only react to these avatars, typed as their ids (they start with avtr_). Leave empty for any avatar. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%avatarId%` | The id of the avatar you switched to |
| `%vrchat.avatarId%` | The same avatar id |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.avatarChanged`</small>

## Avatar parameter changed

Runs when one of your avatar's parameters changes, for example when you turn on a hat from your Action Menu. Movement and voice values that change many times a second are left out.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Parameters** | Only react to these parameters, typed exactly as in your avatar. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |
| **Only when it becomes** | Only react when it becomes this value, for example true or 3. Leave empty for any value. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%parameter%` | The parameter that changed |
| `%value%` | Its new value |
| `%previousValue%` | Its value before (empty the first time) |
| `%type%` | Bool, Int or Float |
| `%vrchat.avatarId%` | The avatar you are wearing |

<small>Type id: `vrchat.parameterChanged`</small>
